name: 3-thioisomescaline
summary: 3-Thioisomescaline (3-TIM), also known as 2,4-dimethoxy-3-methylthiophenethylamine, is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine and scaline families related to mescaline. It is the analogue of isomescaline in which the methoxy group at the 3 position has been replaced with a methylthio group.

pharmacology.text: The effects of 3-TIM have been reported to include possible brief alert and mild stomach upset, with no other effects observed.
